title: THE SECTOR MAP MARKER TAGS GROW AT 4K
why: Found by a 4K text scan of 2026-10-08: on the sector map every word grows with the screen except the marker tags (CACHE, ENCAMPMENT, the locked rooms, KEY, INTEL LIVE), which kept their 1080p size and were tiny on a 4K map. They grow with the screen now, and sit off their markers by the map zoom.
now: At 4K the CACHE and locked room tags on the sector map are full size.
